snippet_primary: "If you opt out of, or are otherwise removed from, Offsite Ads, you will still be charged the advertising fee for any orders placed within 30 days of a buyer's click on your offsite ad, even if that ad is later no longer displayed as part of Offsite Ads (subject to the Last Click Attribution)."
subject_exact: Etsy policy states sellers who opt out of or are removed from Offsite Ads are still charged advertising fees for orders placed within 30 days of a prior buyer click, subject to Last Click Attribution
local_qualifiers: advertising fee applies for 30 days after buyer click even if seller opts out or is removed from Offsite Ads
ad no longer displayed does not waive the fee
